protocol: BLIND — the rendered contact sheet carried ONLY the cell index. Score, clip, frame and box geometry were withheld until after every verdict below was fixed, and joined afterwards by `r5_precision.py`. One concept per sheet, because the concept IS the claim under test.
evidence_class: MEASURED (human visual adjudication of rendered crops). Not INHERITED, not inferred from scores.
measures: PRECISION ONLY. `wrong` = the box does not contain an instance of the concept. RECALL IS NOT MEASURED AND CANNOT BE — that needs exhaustive per-frame ground truth this corpus does not have.

verdict_scheme.correct: the boxed region contains an instance of the concept
verdict_scheme.wrong: the boxed region contains no instance of the concept
verdict_scheme.unclear: cannot be resolved at the available pixel scale. ⚠️ NOT a soft `wrong`. Reported separately and never silently folded into either arm; the headline precision is given BOTH ways (resolvable-only, and unclear-counted-as-wrong) because those bracket the truth.

resolution_note: Frames are 448x179 (the size SAM3 scored); crops were taken from the same frames at the video's native 640x256 and upscaled BICUBIC. Median box area is 71 px2 for `traffic sign` and 34 px2 for `traffic light`, so a high `unclear` rate on the small classes is a property of the INPUT RESOLUTION, not of the adjudicator's diligence.
